Definition: a Chephrite (collectively) or descendants of Chepher
BiblicalUsage: The Chephrites are the descendants of Hepher, named once in the census of Numbers as a family of Manasseh. They stand in the long count of the tribes on the plains of Moab, one household among the thousands being numbered before the land is divided.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God counts households as well as heroes, and no family is lost in His numbering.
